evals.prompt: Design a landing page for a veterinary triage service. You found a polished fintech landing page you want to use as the reference.
evals.expected_output: Rejects direct composition transfer, records a reference-to-principle-to-product-transformation ledger, and introduces a structural choice specific to veterinary triage.
assertions: Applies the logo-swap test and treats an interchangeable result as failure.
Records reference, transferred principle, and product-specific transformation.
Does not present ui-ux-pro-max product/style matches as evidence of specificity.

evals.prompt: Audit this dashboard where alerts, account details, tutorials, invoices, and team members all use the same rounded card with an icon, title, body copy, and hover lift.
evals.expected_output: Names repeated surface grammar as a structural issue and preserves repetition only for components with the same semantic role.
assertions: Names repeated surface grammar or structural uniformity, not merely rounded cards.
Distinguishes semantic repetition from visual-wrapper reuse.
Recommends different structures for unrelated roles.

evals.prompt: Use the bundled ui-ux-pro-max data to decide what makes our warehouse exception-management UI unique, then design it.
evals.expected_output: Uses ui-ux-pro-max only for mechanics, accessibility, and design-system retrieval while deriving specificity from warehouse users, data, and workflows.
assertions: Explicitly refuses to use ui-ux-pro-max as a product-specificity detector.
Uses the corpus for retrieval support such as accessibility, responsive behavior, or design-system mechanics.
Derives at least one structural decision from the warehouse exception-management job.
